machine: MacBook Air Mac16,13, Apple M4, 24 GB
oracle: OFFLINE_ONLY: per-prompt min of target and always-spec medians after formal measurement
sampling: greedy, temperature 0, top-k 0, top-p 1, min-p 0, seed 123
formatting: One user chat message; installed Qwen GGUF chat template; enable_thinking=false
stopping: Server end-of-generation token or 128 generated-token cap; no custom stop strings
timing_boundary: Server post-prefill generation wall clock, matching historical server_slot_stats::t_gen_ms; all request-local guard work inside
generated_token_ids: Direct server generated_tokens; never re-tokenized completion text
committed_progress_C: Count of generated token IDs committed through the speculative execution path through the current completed verification round, including the initial target seed token; excludes uncommitted proposals
zero_C: If a decision is reached with C=0, fall back permanently; if generation ends before a decision, do not manufacture a decision
target_reference_estimator: Median across calibration prompts of (median TARGET_ONLY post-prefill latency across 3 reps / median generated token count across those reps); require positive token counts
spec_estimator: All elapsed charged post-prefill generation and control cost through the current decision / committed progress C
decision: At E completed speculative verification rounds and after each later completed round: continue iff R_spec <= (1 - margin) * R_target_ref; otherwise fall back permanently
fallback: One-way GUARD_K2 speculation-to-target-only transition within a request; no switch-back; target KV/state reconciled before next target-only step

calibration.selection: Lowest prompt-level geometric-mean T_guard/min(T_target,T_always_spec) among exact candidates

qualification.required: 48/48 direct token-ID exact pairs for both ALWAYS_SPEC_K2 and GUARD_K2

invalidation: Any crash, sleep, code/model/environment/freeze drift, incomplete observation, or correctness mismatch retains the whole attempt and prevents selective rerun
